title: Implement FLAC lossless master writer
description:
Create FlacWriter, a libFLAC-backed lossless FLAC master writer that accepts interleaved audio buffers and preserves the negotiated source sample rate and integer bit depth (up to 32-bit). FLAC supports only integer samples; the writer must document and enforce this constraint.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/recording/WavWriter.hpp for SampleFormat and ConversionProvenance enums that may be reusable or must be kept consistent
- The project CMakeLists.txt for libFLAC linkage

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation requirements:
1. Declare class FlacWriter in FlacWriter.hpp with at minimum: open(path, channels, sampleRate, bitsPerSample), write(const int32_t*, frameCount), finalize(), abort(), and isOpen(). Include a provenance() accessor and lastError() for error state.
2. Implement FlacWriter in FlacWriter.cpp using the libFLAC C API (FLAC__stream_encoder_*). On open(), configure the encoder for the requested bitsPerSample (16, 24, or 32), channels, and sample rate. Set compression level to a reasonable default (5). Use FLAC__stream_encoder_init_file().
3. On write(), submit samples via FLAC__stream_encoder_process_interleaved(). Track total frames written.
4. On finalize(), call FLAC__stream_encoder_finish() and verify it returns true; if not, set error state. On abort(), finish the encoder and delete the partial file.
5. Reject Float32/Float64 sample formats at open() time with a clear error; FLAC is integer-only. Document this constraint in the header.
6. Handle encoder errors: if FLAC__stream_encoder_process_interleaved returns false, query FLAC__stream_encoder_get_state() and set lastError().
7. Do not perform blocking I/O inside a PipeWire realtime callback.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: src/recording/FlacWriter.hpp exists and declares FlacWriter class with open, write, finalize, abort, isOpen, provenance, and lastError public interface
src/recording/FlacWriter.cpp exists and uses libFLAC FLAC__stream_encoder_* APIs
FlacWriter supports 16-bit, 24-bit, and 32-bit integer sample depths
FlacWriter rejects float sample formats at open() with a clear error
FlacWriter::finalize() calls FLAC__stream_encoder_finish() and checks its return value
FlacWriter::abort() finishes the encoder and removes the partial file
Encoder errors set a queryable lastError() state
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any file outside src/recording/FlacWriter.hpp and src/recording/FlacWriter.cpp

allowed: define local enums if WavWriter enums are not yet available to include
choose whether to support streaming metadata (FLAC VORBIS_COMMENT) for provenance
forbidden: introduce new third-party dependencies beyond libFLAC
create a base class hierarchy for writers
accept float samples and silently convert to integer
